contact.faq1_q: How quickly do you reply to inquiries?
contact.faq1_a: Within 24 hours on business days. You will receive an automatic confirmation email within 5 minutes of submission, and a sales engineer will follow up with tailored next steps.
contact.faq2_q: What is the MOQ for your products?
contact.faq2_a: MOQ varies by product category, packaging spec and customization depth. Submit an inquiry with your target product and we will provide detailed MOQ and lead time for your specific case.
contact.faq3_q: Can I request a sample? Is it free?
contact.faq3_a: Yes — we typically provide 100–500g free samples for new buyers (shipping at buyer's cost). Submit your request via the inquiry form and our sales engineer will arrange shipment within 1–2 business days.
contact.faq4_q: Which countries/regions do you export to?
contact.faq4_a: We currently export to 5+ regions: Southeast Asia (Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, Philippines, Vietnam), the Middle East (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman), South Asia (India, Bangladesh, Pakistan, Sri Lanka), North America and Europe.
contact.faq5_q: What quality certifications do you hold?
contact.faq5_a: Our facilities are certified to BRCGS, HACCP, HALAL and ISO 22000 standards. Every batch ships with a COA. NDA execution available for custom formulations.
contact.faq6_a: Your inquiry data is used solely to respond to your request. We do not share, sell or trade your information with third parties. See our Privacy Policy for full details.

solutions.faq1_q: How long does a custom R&D project take?
solutions.faq1_a: Simple recipe adjustments: 2–3 weeks. New concept formulation: 4–8 weeks. End-to-end (formula to mass production): 8–12 weeks. Timelines depend on ingredient sourcing, pilot trials and regulatory testing.
solutions.faq2_q: What is the MOQ for custom projects?
solutions.faq2_a: Minimum order quantities for custom projects are scoped per engagement, depending on formulation complexity, ingredient sourcing and packaging format. We tailor each quotation to your application, annual volume and delivery cadence to ensure the most cost-effective solution. Submit a custom inquiry for a detailed proposal.
solutions.faq3_q: Can I retain IP ownership of the formulation?
solutions.faq3_a: Yes. After NDA execution we develop proprietary formulations where IP can be assigned to the client. Non-proprietary base formulas may be co-shared under agreed terms.
solutions.faq4_q: Can you help with regulatory and certifications?
solutions.faq4_a: We assist with Halal, Kosher, ISO 22000, HACCP and BRC certification audits and product testing. Our regulatory team can review labels for destination-market compliance.
